name: Kusanagi Kyou
source:
2nd year university student.
A neighbor of the protagonist, he's been like an older brother to her since they were kids.
They get along well like siblings.
He often comes to visit at her house and even her high school.
But sometimes his personality does a sudden shift and he doesn't show himself.
